note: Substantive updates to the Atlas, most recent first. Each entry records a real verification or reclassification against primary sources.

updates.title: Full primary-source verification pass complete
updates.detail: Every state and DC verified against enrolled statutes and regulator guidance, with a pincite recorded for each: bill number, public act, and codified citation. Secondary sources removed.

updates.title: Reclassified to a live licensing regime
updates.detail: Verified against HB 1272. Georgia moved to Live, with a two-tier detail covering transmission licensing and its emerging issuer pathway.

updates.title: Verified against DACPA, DAKA and SB 3412; Digital Asset Tax Act added
updates.detail: Confirmed the Digital Assets and Consumer Protection Act (Public Act 104-0428) reaches stablecoins under Section (4)(B), added the kiosk caps in the Digital Asset Kiosk Act, and recorded the SB 3412 money-transmission changes.

updates.title: Added HB 701 (2025) blockchain carve-outs
updates.detail: Recorded the digital-asset carve-outs at KRS 286.11-007(8) and KRS chapter 369.

updates.title: Updated to 2023 Act 267 (new MTMA)
updates.detail: Money transmission now sits under Wis. Stat. ch. 217. The DFI interpretation keeps virtual-currency transmission outside licensing, so Wisconsin stays VC Excluded.

updates.title: Regulator named for every jurisdiction
updates.detail: Each state card now identifies the specific agency that administers money-transmission and virtual-currency licensing.

updates.title: Consistent summary and issuer checklist added
updates.detail: Every entry now carries a plain-language summary and a 'What issuers must do' key-points layer.

updates.title: Stable Token Act primary-sourced
updates.detail: Verified the Wyoming Stable Token Act (SF0127 / Enrolled Act 85, W.S. 40-31-101 to 109) and the digital-asset taxonomy at W.S. 34-29-101 that anchors the virtual-currency exemption.

updates.title: Reconciled to HB 3521 enrolled text
updates.detail: Corrected the current-law citation to the Financial Transaction Reporting Act (6 O.S. 1511 et seq.) and added kiosk rules from 6 O.S. 1520.1.

updates.title: Current and incoming law separated
updates.detail: Split the current two-party-exemption regime (ch. 560) from the incoming HB 175 issuer license.

updates.title: Treasury Section 3 NPRM added; GENIUS effective date noted
updates.detail: Added the Section 3 prohibitions NPRM and the expected GENIUS Act effective date of January 18, 2027.

updates.title: Current DFS regime clarified
updates.detail: Confirmed the 2022 DFS guidance as the current regime, with proposed Part 202 as its successor.
